data.one_liner: A rectangular border with variable smoothness imitated from Figma.
data.what_it_does: Provides custom widgets and shape borders like SmoothContainer, SmoothCard, and SmoothRectangleBorder to implement smooth iOS-style rounded corners and squircles in Flutter.
use_when: You want to implement Figma-style corner smoothing or iOS-style squircles in your Flutter app.
You need custom rounded shapes with adjustable smoothness ranging from standard rounded rectangles to superellipses.
avoid_when: You only need standard Flutter rounded rectangles without custom Figma-style smoothness.
You are looking for complex layout widgets or full component UI libraries.
strengths: Adjustable smoothness parameter to control the exact curve of the corners.
Provides built-in drop-in replacements for common widgets like Container, Card, and ClipRRect.
Exposes SmoothRectangleBorder for custom ShapeDecoration and clipping uses.
weaknesses: Limited to rectangle border smoothness and specific wrapper widgets.
No documentation on performance impacts for heavy lists containing many smooth corners.
data.minimal_example:
SmoothContainer(
  width: 200,
  height: 200,
  smoothness: 0.6,
  side: BorderSide(color: Colors.cyan, width: 2),
  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(40),
  child: child,
  alignment: Alignment.center,
)
